notes.title: Cooking Live Update: Enhanced Experiences Await!
notes.notes: Cooking Live latest update fixes issues encountered in various restaurants. Enjoy smoother, more delightful culinary adventures now! 🎉

notes.title: Enhanced Performance and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to roll out the latest update for our game! After listening to your valuable feedback, we've tackled some key issues that were affecting your gaming experience.

Bug Fixes & Performance Enhancements:

Loading and Login Bugs: Say goodbye to those annoying loading and login issues – they've been fixed!
Optimized Gameplay: We've fine-tuned the game's performance, ensuring smoother and more responsive gameplay than ever before.

Get ready for a noticeably smoother and more responsive gaming experience. 
As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. If you notice any other issues or just want to share your thoughts, feel free to drop us a message.

Happy gaming, and thanks for being an awesome part of our community!

notes.title: New Episode: Family Recipe (macOS Update)
notes.notes: Join the son of a renowned chef as he opens his very own restaurant. Amidst simmering family drama, he's focused on one thing - cooking up the town's best burgers using a secret family recipe. Will he flip his way to fame or get grilled under pressure?

notes.title: New Episode: Family Recipe (Windows Update)
notes.notes:
Join the son of a renowned chef as he opens his very own restaurant. Amidst simmering family drama, he's focused on one thing - cooking up the town's best burgers using a secret family recipe. Will he flip his way to fame or get grilled under pressure?

Please note that while this update is currently available for Windows only, we are actively working on bringing the new episode to macOS. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: The macOS version of Cooking Live is out!

Cooking Live is now available on one more platform!
Join Jane and thousands of other passionate players and put deliciousness back on the table!

notes.title: Update 0.30. PRE-RECORDED Content
notes.notes: Let's check out the update together!

notes.title: Update 0.30
notes.notes:
- Updates to how the restaurant in the “Sirene Movie Theater” episode works:
We redesigned several objects and changed how the equipment works. It’s like a whole new restaurant now!

- Changes to the shop:
We removed the tabs and improved the offers.

- Equipment delivery fine-tuned:
Get upgrades without going back to the home screen.

- Updates to the interface:
We improved the placement of the button that takes you to a new restaurant and added a button that closes the victory window.

notes.title: New Year update
notes.notes:
- Help one of Santa’s elves save Christmas!
- Enjoy a new seasonal title sequence on the home screen!

Update the game to take part in this amazing travel adventure and collect dozens of rewards!
